scope: Source-reviewed major season-ending injuries across NBA teams; targeted expansion, not a complete all-team injury archive.
model_rules: Apply only after known_from to affected_season.
Never infer a season-ending forecast from later realized zero games.
Do not count cumulative current_games as evidence of a return after an injury.
